text.tspan: the best step is not always the best sentence
A sentence’s probability is a product

is the probability of its first token, times the second given the first, times the third given both, and so on. Greedy maximises each factor on its own. That is not the same as maximising the product: a slightly worse first token can make every later one far more likely.

D · The other branch of the same loop — sampling
When the single most likely answer is not what you want
Greedy always gives the same, often repetitive, answer. Sampling draws the next token from the probabilities instead. The temperature T sharpens (
) the distribution before the draw, and top-k removes every token outside the k best, so a rare wrong token can never be drawn.
